materials.intended_surface: Warm ochre sandstone blocks with restrained ancient geometric shallow incisions
materials.semantic: diffuse color only; not physically calibrated albedo

qa.visual_review: Original atlas and 2x2 repeat sheet visually reviewed. Surface identity/color pass; motif breaks may occur at repeat boundaries. Preserve as bounded-span original; use preferred_files for large wall/ground repeats where present.
known_limitations: Generated opposing edges are not mathematically matched. Edge and motif discontinuities may be visible; not certified seamless.
Contains painted surface shading, but no intentionally baked cast shadows.
No normal, roughness, metallic, AO, height or emission maps are supplied.

repeat_alternative.name: Subtle warm ochre sandstone with faint dusty terracotta mottles and tiny green patina flecks
repeat_alternative.semantic: diffuse color; not physically calibrated albedo
repeat_alternative.processing: Imagegen targeted quieter-motif correction; quadrant nearest-resampled to320 square, crop-only edge-similarity selection, nearest-resampled to256 and128. No pixel blending, painting, mirroring or synthetic map derivation.

qa.visual_review: Visually inspected actual256-pixel texture repeated2x2. No dominant hard boundary or tonal step; painterly material identity retained. Fine motif discontinuities can remain, especially close-up. Use alternative on repeated wall/ground spans; keep original for architectural or landmark detail.
qa.limits: Crop can lower boundary color mismatch, but does not prove motif continuity or equal boundary pixels. In-engine distance, UV and lighting acceptance required.

materials.preferred_usage: Use repeat alternative on broad repeating surfaces; use original files on bounded slabs/bays for richer macro detail.

qa_notes: All original 2x2 repeat sheets reviewed; original macro motifs are bounded-span materials with imperfect repeat continuity. Targeted imagegen edits supplied quieter wall/ground alternatives, then crop-only edge selection and nearest resize; all alternative 2x2 sheets reviewed as visually usable repeats. None is mathematically seamless-certified. No fake PBR maps.
package_scope: Runtime textures, selected native previews and JSON QA are included. Original masters are in the optional lossless source-art bundle. Historical per-theme repeat/contact PNGs are retained locally, not shipped; regenerate diagnostics from runtime PNGs with assembly-src/render_material_qa.py.
